participant_1.name: Alex Johnson
participant_1.personality: Determined and nostalgic, Alex is deeply passionate about his achievements and has a whimsical side with his love for hats.
participant_1.background: I won a gold medal in the 1992 Olympics. I love cats and have two cats. I have a hat collection of over 1000 hats. I have a weakness for vanilla ice cream. My favorite season is winter.

participant_2.name: Emma Smith
participant_2.personality: Ambitious and adventurous, Emma is a dreamer who aspires to make a name for herself in the city, while being grounded in her rural upbringing.
participant_2.background: My family has raised horses for generations. I want to be a lawyer. I was raised on a horse farm. I'm from a small town. I dream of moving to the city.
